streaky-bay-5.name: The Granites
streaky-bay-5.bio: Granite outcrops, a sandy lagoon and rock pools below a 110-step staircase from the clifftop car park.

notes.pin: Staircase car park on Westall Way (Granites beach, ~110 steps down)

streaky-bay-5.ticket_note: Open place with no single steward; no official page to link.

streaky-bay-6.name: Smooth Pool
streaky-bay-6.bio: A flat granite shelf holding calm rock-lined pools for swimming, snorkelling and exploring at low tide.

notes.pin: Smooth Pool access on Westall Way Loop

streaky-bay-6.ticket_note: Open place with no single steward; no official page to link.

streaky-bay-7.name: High Cliff
streaky-bay-7.bio: A clifftop lookout on Westall Way over the rugged cliffs and turquoise water of the Southern Ocean.

notes.pin: High Cliff Lookout on Westall Way Loop, ~20 km from town

streaky-bay-7.ticket_note: Open place with no single steward; no official page to link.

streaky-bay-8.name: Yanerbie Sandhills
streaky-bay-8.bio: Endless white sandhills on Westall Way to climb, with sandboarding and a safe swimming beach beside them.

notes.pin: Yanerbie Road car park at the dunes, Westall Way
notes.fact: Regional tourism page: free; Westall Way Loop.

streaky-bay-8.ticket_note: Open place with no single steward; no official page to link.

streaky-bay-9.name: Streaky Bay Back Beach
streaky-bay-9.bio: A sealed 8 km drive from town to a reef-break surf beach with rock pools to explore at low tide.

notes.pin: Back Beach car park, Back Beach Road, 8 km from town
notes.fact: Surf beach with rock pools at low tide; 8 km sealed road from town.

streaky-bay-9.ticket_note: Open place with no single steward; no official page to link.

streaky-bay-10.name: Streaky Bay Jetty
streaky-bay-10.bio: A 350 m jetty on the town foreshore for fishing, walking and bay views, with a shark-proof swimming area.

notes.pin: Jetty root at foreshore, Bay Road / Alfred Terrace

streaky-bay-10.ticket_note: Open place with no single steward; no official page to link.

streaky-bay-11.name: Streaky Bay Powerhouse Museum
streaky-bay-11.bio: Over 400 restored working engines, from industrial machines to miniatures, run for visitors in the old power house.
streaky-bay-11.ticket_note: No official site of its own found; only the regional tourism listing (Tue and Fri 2-5pm). Not linked.

notes.fact: Entry by donation; open Tue and Fri 2-5pm per regional tourism listing.

streaky-bay-12.name: Streaky Bay Museum
streaky-bay-12.bio: A National Trust museum of local history and historic vehicles on Montgomerie Terrace.
streaky-bay-12.ticket_note: National Trust SA page for it returned 404; no verified official site.

notes.fact: Town tourism site lists Tue and Fri 9am-2pm, Wed 10am-2pm at 42 Montgomerie Terrace.

streaky-bay-13.name: Streaky Bay Great White Shark Replica
streaky-bay-13.bio: A 5 m fibreglass model of a great white caught off Streaky Bay in 1990, the town's most photographed stop.
streaky-bay-13.ticket_note: Open place with no single steward; no official page to link.

streaky-bay-14.name: Point Labatt Conservation Park
streaky-bay-14.bio: The mainland's only permanent colony of endangered Australian sea lions, watched from a clifftop platform.

notes.pin: Clifftop viewing platform, Point Labatt Conservation Park (draft coordinates kept)
notes.fact: NPWS SA page: Free entry, open daily; closed on catastrophic fire danger days. Platform is 50 m above the beach.

streaky-bay-15.name: Baird Bay
streaky-bay-15.bio: A small bay where operators take guests snorkelling with wild sea lions and dolphins around Jones Island.

notes.pin: Baird Bay settlement / Baird Bay Experience base (draft coordinates kept)
notes.fact: Sea Lion & Dolphin Swim from $300 per adult (operator site); runs Thu-Mon 1 Oct to 30 Apr, weather permitting. Regional listing showed older $160.

streaky-bay-16.name: Sceale Bay
streaky-bay-16.bio: A small village on a bay south of Streaky Bay, close to Surfers Beach for surfing and swimming.
streaky-bay-16.ticket_note: Place with no single steward; no ticketUrl.

notes.pin: Sceale Bay village / Surfers Beach car park ~28 km south of Streaky Bay (draft coordinates kept)
